snippet.title: Thin Judgment - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/661460

Thin Judgment is a game about picking up items from a conveyor belt and playing around with sentient paper beings. Of course, fire is the best toy.

This is an indie game made in Unity over the course of a year by myself.
